description: Find the official California jury instruction NUMBER for a claim, cause of action, or criminal charge by keyword — "breach of contract" -> CACI No. 303; "first degree murder" -> a CALCRIM number; "self-defense", "negligence", "false imprisonment". Searches official instruction/verdict-form TITLES and series names across CACI (civil), CALCRIM (criminal), or both. Returns matching numbers/titles — call caci_lookup or calcrim_lookup with a number for the full text. This is a title search, not full-text search over instruction bodies. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Claim, cause of action, or charge, e.g. "breach of contract" or "first degree murder".

name: ca_ji_search
title: Ca Ji Search
